title: SPIRS-P1 Cyprus Longitudinal Validation: Manuscript Analysis Code
description: Audited analysis code for external longitudinal evaluation of SPIRS-P1 on the public Cyprus/PROTEAS brain-metastasis MRI dataset. The release covers denominator auditing, reference-mask relinking, cross-sectional rescoring, patient-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals, whole-burden change, and reference-anchored modified RANO-BM endpoints. It excludes imaging, clinical data, trained weights, predictions, and patient-level results.
